focus.zh: AI 数据中心的算热协同
focus.en: Coordinating Compute and Cooling in AI Data Centres

intro.zh: 我关注算力负载和冷却系统如何协同。目前主要做数据中心液冷系统建模、仿真与控制实验，也开发用于实验监测和数据查询的 AI 工具。
intro.en: I study how computing workloads and cooling systems interact in AI data centres. My current work covers liquid-cooling system modelling and control experiments, as well as software for lab monitoring and AI-assisted data queries.

description.zh: 段培耀，清华大学毕业，关注 AI 数据中心的算热协同。研究与项目包括液冷系统建模与控制、实验监测与 AI 助手、风机尾流预测。
description.en: Peiyao Duan, a Tsinghua University graduate studying compute and cooling in AI data centres. Projects include liquid-cooling control, AI-assisted lab monitoring, and neural wake prediction.

zh.note: 本科毕业。以数理方法理解问题，以工程实践检验想法。

en.note: Undergraduate education, completed. A foundation in mathematics, physics, and engineering practice.

en.title: Shuimuhui · Campus services
en.text: Developed campus review, class-group, and profile modules; introduced a component library and wrote front-end guidelines.

en.title: Acoustic metamaterial design
en.text: Designed an annular structure balancing sound absorption and airflow, with COMSOL simulation and bench measurements.

about.zh: 我在清华大学学习数理基础科学和能源与动力工程。现在，我用热流体模型和控制实验研究数据中心的冷却系统，也编写工具整理和查询实验数据。支教期间，我在拉萨教授信息科技，设计 Scratch 和网页项目课。
about.en: I studied mathematics, physics, and energy and power engineering at Tsinghua University. I now use thermofluid models and control experiments to study data centre cooling and build tools to organise and query lab data. During my volunteer teaching placement in Lhasa, I teach computing and design Scratch and web project lessons.
